h.en: 6.1.1 Why balancing is necessary: force and couple
h.gu: 6.1.1 Balancing નો હેતુ: Force અને Couple

body.en:
An unbalanced rotating mass produces a periodic force of magnitude mr omega². The resulting bearing forces, vibration, noise and fatigue can damage supports, reduce accuracy and loosen fasteners. Balancing modifies the mass distribution so that unwanted inertia forces and moments cancel to the required tolerance.

Static balance requires the mass centre on the rotation axis, equivalent to zero resultant unbalance vector. Dynamic balance also requires zero resultant unbalance couple. Equal opposite masses in different planes can give static balance but leave a rotating couple. Balancing is not the same as shaft alignment or repairing a damaged bearing.
body.gu:
Unbalanced rotating mass mr omega² periodic force આપે. Bearing loads,vibration,noise,fatigue થી supports/accuracy/fasteners ને નુકસાન. Balancing mass distribution સુધારી inertia force/moment tolerance મુજબ cancel કરે.

Static balance: centre of mass axis પર, resultant unbalance zero. Dynamic balance: resultant couple પણ zero. Different planes માં equal opposite masses force cancel કરી couple છોડી શકે. Alignment/bearing repair balancing થી અલગ.

body.en:
Construction: place a correction mass mb at radius rb in the same transverse plane as the original mass m at radius r, and at180° opposite its angular position.

Working: both inertia forces have the same omega² factor, so equilibrium requires mb rb=m r. A larger available correction radius needs less mass for the same unbalance. If the correction lies in another plane, a couple can remain and the single-plane result is not sufficient. Never attach arbitrary loose weights to a machine; correction methods, attachment and residual tolerance require qualified procedures.
body.gu:
Construction: original m,r વાળી same transverse plane માં correction mb,rb ને180° opposite મૂકો.

Working: બંને forces માં omega² common, એટલે mb rb=m r. Larger rb માટે ઓછું mb. Different plane હોય તો couple બાકી રહી શકે. Arbitrary loose weights machine પર ન લગાવો; attachment/tolerance qualified procedure મુજબ.

h.en: 6.1.3 Several masses in one plane: analytical method

body.en:
Choose a common angular zero and counterclockwise positive direction. Compute Ux=sum(mi ri cos theta_i), Uy=sum(mi ri sin theta_i), using kg·m. Resultant unbalance U=sqrt(Ux²+Uy²). Its direction is atan2(Uy,Ux), which preserves the correct quadrant.

At correction radius rb, mb=U/rb and theta_b=atan2(Uy,Ux)+180° reduced to0–360°. Speed cancels because all masses rotate at the same angular speed in the same plane. Do not add mass magnitudes without their radii/angles. These equations are not the full two-plane dynamic-balancing method.
body.gu:
Common zero તથા counterclockwise positive લો. Ux=sum(mi ri cos theta_i), Uy=sum(mi ri sin theta_i), units kg·m. U=sqrt(Ux²+Uy²); angle atan2(Uy,Ux) યોગ્ય quadrant આપે.

Correction mb=U/rb, angle=resultant angle+180° modulo360°. Same speed/same plane હોવાથી omega² cancel. માત્ર masses ઉમેરવી નહિ; radii/angles જરૂરી. આ full two-plane balancing નથી.

body.en:
Masses2 kg at r=.10 m,theta0°, and3 kg at r=.10 m,theta90°, rotate in the same plane. Ux=.20 kg·m, Uy=.30 kg·m; U=sqrt(.2²+.3²)=.36056 kg·m. Resultant angle=atan2(.30,.20)=56.31°.

At rb=.15 m, correction mass=.36056/.15=2.4037 kg at236.31°. Check: the correction components are−.20 and−.30 kg·m, so both sums become zero. A mass at56.31° would reinforce, not balance, the unbalance.
body.gu:
2kg,r.10m,theta0° અને3kg,r.10m,theta90° same plane. Ux.20,Uy.30 kg·m; U.36056kg·m; resultant angle56.31°.

rb.15m માટે mb2.4037kg અને angle236.31°. Check correction components−.20,−.30 તેથી બંને sums zero.56.31° પર correction મૂકતાં unbalance વધે, cancel નહિ.

h.en: 6.1.5 Worked balancing problem 2 and graphical polygon

body.en:
Take2 kg at.10 m,0°;3 kg at.10 m,90°;2 kg at.10 m,180°. The first and third horizontal vectors cancel, leaving U=.30 kg·m upward. At rb=.15 m, mb=2.0 kg at270°.

Graphical method: choose a scale such as1 cm=.10 kg·m; draw successive mr vectors head-to-tail at their actual angles. The closing vector from the final point back to the start is the required balancing mr, not the forward resultant. Measure its magnitude and direction and divide by rb to find mass. Repeat the analytical check to detect drawing error.
body.gu:
2kg,.10m,0°;3kg,.10m,90°;2kg,.10m,180°. Horizontal vectors cancel, U.30kg·m upward. rb.15m માટે mb2kg at270°.

Graphical: scale1cm=.10kg·m લો, mr vectors actual angles સાથે head-to-tail દોરો. Last point થી start સુધી closing vector balancing mr છે, forward resultant નહિ. તેની length/direction માપી rb થી divide કરો; analytical check થી drawing error શોધો.

body.en:
Vibration is oscillatory motion about an equilibrium position. Amplitude is maximum departure; period is time for one cycle; frequency f=1/period in Hz; phase describes relative timing. Natural frequency is the frequency of free oscillation of a system, not necessarily its operating shaft frequency.

A simple linear mass-spring-damper model is m x-double-dot+c x-dot+kx=F(t). The undamped natural frequency is fn=(1/2pi)sqrt(k/m). Real machines may have many modes, each with its own shape/frequency; the single-DOF drawing is an explanatory idealisation.
body.gu:
Vibration equilibrium આસપાસ oscillation. Amplitude=max departure; period=એક cycle time; f=1/period Hz; phase=relative timing. Natural frequency free oscillation ની frequency, shaft running frequency હોવું જરૂરી નથી.

Simple linear model m x-double-dot+c x-dot+kx=F(t), undamped fn=(1/2pi)sqrt(k/m). Actual machine ના multiple modes હોઈ શકે; single-DOF diagram ideal model છે.

h.en: 6.2.2 Free, forced, damped and resonant vibration
h.gu: 6.2.2 Free, Forced, Damped અને Resonant Vibration

body.en:
Free vibration follows an initial disturbance without continued periodic forcing. Forced vibration is maintained by an external excitation such as rotating unbalance. Damping dissipates vibration energy, so an unforced damped response decays.

Longitudinal vibration moves along a member axis, transverse vibration across it, and torsional vibration twists about it. Resonance is large response when forcing frequency approaches a relevant natural frequency, limited by damping and nonlinear effects. A machine can have more than one resonance; operating speed changes can move excitation into or out of a dangerous range.
body.gu:
Free vibration initial disturbance પછી periodic external forcing વગર. Forced vibration unbalance જેવી excitation થી maintained. Damping energy dissipate કરે એટલે unforced response decay થાય.

Longitudinal axis along; transverse across; torsional twisting. Forcing frequency relevant natural frequency પાસે આવે ત્યારે resonance થી response વધે; damping/nonlinear effects limit કરે. Multiple resonances શક્ય; speed બદલતાં dangerous range માં જઈ શકાય.

h.en: 6.2.3 Causes, harmful effects and practical remedies

body.en:
Causes include rotor unbalance, misalignment, looseness, worn bearings/gears, reciprocating forces, poor foundations and external periodic forces. Effects include noise, fatigue cracking, fastener loosening, poor surface finish, measurement errors and discomfort.

Remedies: remove the cause by balancing, alignment, proper fastening and repair; adjust stiffness/mass to shift natural frequency when professionally assessed; add suitable damping; use correctly designed isolation mounts. Isolation is not guaranteed at all frequencies and may worsen resonance. Trend vibration with rated instruments and known baseline, isolate before inspection, and seek qualified diagnosis rather than assuming every vibration is mass unbalance.
body.gu:
Causes: unbalance,misalignment,looseness,worn bearings/gears,reciprocating forces,weak foundations,external forces. Effects: noise,fatigue,loose fasteners,poor finish,measurement errors,discomfort.

Remedies: actual cause repair/balance/align/fasten; professional assessment થી stiffness/mass shift; suitable damping/isolation. Isolation દરેક frequency પર કામ કરે જ એવું નહિ, resonance વધારી શકે. Baseline સાથે measurements trend કરો અને inspection પહેલાં isolate કરો.
